annotations.title: Read the Substack writers you follow

description: Recent free posts from the Substack publications the user reads, newest first, each with its writer, publication and text. `writer` matches a writer or publication name, `query` matches titles. Paid issues and publications the user gets by email are saved as newsletters, so read those with read_my_newsletters.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to match in titles.

writer.description: Writer or publication name to match.
